Reading in assessed LLM and manual extractions and quantifying the concordance 
between the two extraction methods.

Assessment of concordance is based on the following categories:

- Text level agreement
    - Text extracted by both methods
    - Text extracted only by LLM
    - Text extracted only by manual extraction

- Outcome level agreement
    - Similar outcomes extracted by both methods
    - Outcomes extracted only by LLM
    - Outcomes extracted only by manual extraction

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dotenv)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(tidyr)
library(kableExtra)

#######################################################
# Initialising file paths
#######################################################

readRenviron(here("config.env"))

interim_data <- Sys.getenv("interimdatadir")
evaluation_output_dir <- Sys.getenv("evaluationoutputdir")

evaluation_dir <- file.path(interim_data, "reported_outcomes/Extraction_Evaluation")

```

```{r}
#| label: Functions
#| include: false
#| echo: false

# Creating a summary table of the number of outcomes extracted by both methods, only LLM, and only manual extraction

create_text_level_agreement_table <- function(evaluation){
  
  both_methods <- evaluation %>%
      filter(match_status == "Matched") %>%
      select(Evidence_Text_LLM, Evidence_Text_manual) %>%
      unique() %>%
      nrow()

  only_llm <- evaluation %>%
      filter(match_status == "Only in LLM") %>%
      select(Evidence_Text_LLM) %>%
      unique()

  n_only_llm <- nrow(only_llm)

  only_manual <- evaluation %>%
      filter(match_status == "Only in manual") %>%
      select(Evidence_Text_manual) %>%
      unique()

  n_only_manual <- nrow(only_manual)

  precision <- both_methods / (both_methods + n_only_llm) * 100

  recall <- both_methods / (both_methods + n_only_manual) * 100

  f1 <- 2 * (precision * recall) / (precision + recall)

  text_level_agreement <- data.frame(
    Metric = c("Both Methods", "LLM Only", "Manual Only", "Precision", "Recall", "F1"),
    Value = c(both_methods, n_only_llm, n_only_manual, precision, recall, f1)
  ) %>%
    mutate(Value = round(Value, 0))

  return(list(text_level_agreement = text_level_agreement, only_llm = only_llm, only_manual = only_manual))
}

create_outcome_level_agreement_table <- function(evaluation){

  outcome_level <- evaluation %>%
    filter(match_status == "Matched")

  n_captured_manual <- 0

  missed_manual <- data.frame()

  for(i in unique(outcome_level$Evidence_Text_manual)){

    extraction <- outcome_level %>%
      filter(Evidence_Text_manual == i)

    for(j in unique(extraction$Outcome_manual)){

      agreement <- extraction %>%
        filter(Outcome_manual == j) %>%
        select(Agreement)

      if(any(agreement == "Yes")){

        n_captured_manual <- n_captured_manual + 1

      } else {

        missed_manual <- rbind(missed_manual, extraction %>%
                          filter(Outcome_manual == j) %>%
                          select(Outcome_LLM, Outcome_manual, Evidence_Text_LLM, Evidence_Text_manual, Agreement, Comment)
        )
      }
    }
  }

  n_captured_LLM <- 0

  missed_LLM <- data.frame()

  for(i in unique(outcome_level$Evidence_Text_LLM)){

    extraction <- outcome_level %>%
      filter(Evidence_Text_LLM == i)

    for(j in unique(extraction$Outcome_LLM)){

      agreement <- extraction %>%
        filter(Outcome_LLM == j) %>%
        select(Agreement)

      if(any(agreement == "Yes")){

        n_captured_LLM <- n_captured_LLM + 1

      } else {

        missed_LLM <- rbind(missed_LLM, extraction %>%
                          filter(Outcome_LLM == j) %>%
                          select(Outcome_LLM, Outcome_manual, Evidence_Text_LLM, Evidence_Text_manual, Agreement, Comment)
        )
      }
    }
  }

  LLM_recall <- n_captured_manual / (n_captured_manual + nrow(missed_manual)) * 100
  LLM_precision <- n_captured_LLM / (n_captured_LLM + nrow(missed_LLM)) * 100
  LLM_f1 <- 2 * (LLM_precision * LLM_recall) / (LLM_precision + LLM_recall)

  outcome_level_agreement <- data.frame(
    Metric = c("Manual Outcomes Captured by LLM", "Manual Outcomes Missed by LLM", "LLM Outcomes Captured by Manual", "LLM Outcomes Missed by Manual", "LLM Recall", "LLM Precision", "LLM F1"),
    Value = c(n_captured_manual, nrow(missed_manual), n_captured_LLM, nrow(missed_LLM), LLM_recall, LLM_precision, LLM_f1)
  ) %>%
    mutate(Value = round(Value, 0))

  return(list(outcome_level_agreement = outcome_level_agreement, missed_manual = missed_manual, missed_LLM = missed_LLM))
}

```

```{r}
#| label: Extraction Evaluation
#| include: true
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

reports <- c("Reprotox", "TERIS", "UKTIS")

for(r in reports){

  cat("#", r, "\n\n")

  evaluation_dir <- file.path(evaluation_dir, r, "5_mapped_ordered_agreement")

  evaluation_files <- evaluation_dir %>%
    list.files(, pattern = "mapped_ordered_agreement.csv", full.names = T)

  for (f in evaluation_files) {

    evaluation <- f %>%
      fread()

    #######################################################
    # Text Level Agreement Quantification
    #######################################################

    # Creating a summary table of the number of outcomes extracted by both methods, only LLM, and only manual extraction
    text_level_agreement <- create_text_level_agreement_table(evaluation)

    #######################################################
    # Outcome Level Agreement Quantification
    #######################################################

    outcome_level_agreement <- create_outcome_level_agreement_table(evaluation)

    #######################################################
    # Print Tables and Disagreeing Extractions
    #######################################################
    drug_name <- basename(f) %>%
      gsub("_mapped_ordered_agreement.csv", "", .) %>%
      gsub("_", " ", .)

    cat("##", drug_name, "\n\n")
      
    cat("###", "Text Level Agreement", "\n\n")

    cat("Summary Table", "\n\n")

    cat(knitr::kable(
        text_level_agreement$text_level_agreement,
        caption = "Text-level agreement") %>%
          kable_styling(font_size = 14),
        sep = "\n")

    if(nrow(text_level_agreement$only_llm) == 0 & nrow(text_level_agreement$only_manual) == 0){
      cat("No disagreeing extractions found.", "\n\n")
    } else {
      cat("Disagreeing Extractions", "\n\n")
    }

    if(nrow(text_level_agreement$only_llm) != 0){
      
      cat(knitr::kable(
          text_level_agreement$only_llm,
          caption = "Text extracted only by LLM") %>%
            kable_styling(font_size = 14),
          sep = "\n")
    }

    if(nrow(text_level_agreement$only_manual) != 0){
      cat(knitr::kable(
          text_level_agreement$only_manual,
          caption = "Text extracted only by manual extraction") %>%
            kable_styling(font_size = 14),
          sep = "\n")
    }

    cat("###", "Outcome Level Agreement", "\n\n")

    cat("Summary Table", "\n\n")

    cat(knitr::kable(
        outcome_level_agreement$outcome_level_agreement,
        caption = "Outcome-level agreement") %>%
          kable_styling(font_size = 14),
        sep = "\n")

    if(nrow(outcome_level_agreement$missed_manual) == 0 & nrow(outcome_level_agreement$missed_LLM) == 0){
      cat("No disagreeing extractions found.", "\n\n")
    } else {
      cat("Disagreeing Extractions", "\n\n")
    }

    if(nrow(outcome_level_agreement$missed_manual) != 0){
      cat(knitr::kable(
          outcome_level_agreement$missed_manual,
          caption = "Outcomes extracted only by manual extraction") %>%
            kable_styling(font_size = 14),
          sep = "\n")
    }

    if(nrow(outcome_level_agreement$missed_LLM) != 0){
      cat(knitr::kable(
          outcome_level_agreement$missed_LLM,
          caption = "Outcomes extracted only by LLM") %>%
            kable_styling(font_size = 14),
          sep = "\n")
    }
  }
}
```
